panels.detailed_description: Three horizontal strips, each a continuous red ECG trace on a light grey millimetre grid. A rectangular calibration pulse is drawn at the left start of the first strip. Small grey time labels run along the bottom of each strip from 0 s to 9 s in the first strip, 10 s to 19 s in the second and 20 s to 29 s in the third. panels.detailed_description: Photographed ECG paper with a pink millimetre grid in a three-row by four-column lead layout plus a long rhythm strip at the bottom. Printed lead labels are I, aVR, V1 and V4 in the first row; II, aVL, V2 and V5 in the second; III, aVF, V3 and V6 in the third; and II on the bottom strip. A rectangular calibration pulse starts each row at the left. The complexes are narrow and closely and unevenly spaced, with larger deflections in the precordial leads V1 to V6 at the right. The paper edge and slight perspective are visible; no name, date, scanner text or other identifying marks are visible.

visual.general_description: Colour mechanism diagram of factors feeding into atrial fibrillation.
visual.detailed_description: One whole-figure schematic with a central heart labelled "Atrial fibrillation" and four boxed factor groups with arrows pointing to it. No patient data or identifying text is visible.

panels.general_description: Colour schematic with four labelled boxes of listed factors, each with an arrow pointing to a central heart labelled Atrial fibrillation.
panels.detailed_description: A cartoon heart with a small ECG strip above it sits in the centre, labelled "Atrial fibrillation". Four rounded boxes surround it. The pink box at the upper left is titled "Neurohumoral and metabolic factors" and lists Thyrotoxicosis, Electrolyte imbalances, Metabolic syndrome, Obesity, Diabesity, Obstructive sleep apnoea syndrome, Alcohol consumption and Smoking. The green box at the upper right is titled "Constitutional factors" and lists Genetics, Aging, Male sex and Ethnicity. The blue box at the lower left is titled "Autonomic dysregulation" and lists Sympathetic activation and Parasympathetic activation. The yellow box at the lower right is titled "Hemodynamic overload" with a down arrow to "Atrial remodeling" and lists Valvular heart disease, Hypertension, Coronary heart disease, Cardiomyopathies, Myocarditis, Pericarditis, Heart failure, Congenital heart disease and Previous cardiac surgery. A pale arrow from each box points toward the heart.
